## Audit tamper suite

12/12 scenarios behaved as designed.

| Scenario | Designed outcome | Observed | Failure kinds reported |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UPDATE an audit event through the application role | prevented | prevented | none |
| DELETE an audit event through the application role | prevented | prevented | none |
| Owner disables the trigger and flips one recorded decision from deny to allow | detected | detected | decision_mismatch, hash_mismatch |
| Owner rewrites who approved an action, recomputing that event's own hash | detected | detected | prev_hash_mismatch |
| Owner backdates one event | detected | detected | hash_mismatch |
| Owner deletes one event from the middle of the chain | detected | detected | prev_hash_mismatch, seq_gap |
| Owner swaps the order of two adjacent events | detected | detected | hash_mismatch, prev_hash_mismatch |
| Edit actions.decision for a denied action to allow (actions has no trigger) | detected | detected | decision_mismatch |
| Mark a still-pending action as approved without an approval event | detected | detected | status_mismatch |
| Insert an allowed action row that never went through evaluation | detected | detected | missing_evaluation_event |
| Owner deletes the newest event (a policy change) | detected with checkpoint only | detected with checkpoint only | checkpoint_missing |
| Owner edits a policy.created event and recomputes every later hash | detected with checkpoint only | detected with checkpoint only | checkpoint_mismatch |
